name: Kawamori Keiko
source:
Keiko is the manager and a barmaid of the Cafe "Fir Tree". She is [url=https://vndb.org/c38472]Yousuke[/url]'s boss at his part-time waiter job. Although her business is struggling, she pays Yousuke a nice salary, as she knows how tough it is to be alone. Because of all that he’s been through, she does all she can for him, although it’s not easy for her.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/565978-tsuki-possession/faqs/28692]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url] and Erogereview]
